The northern run is independently identified by the heritage locator. The mapped outer polygon is split at the inset corner between the two connected livestock barns.

The eastern leg is identified in the heritage locator. Its country cadastral shape shares a party edge with the northern barn, with outbuilding division set from the inner corner and the survey lengths.

The national heritage record locates the gate north of the livestock barn. The register describes the wall joining the northwest chapel to the barns. The exact masonry alignment between those controls is estimated.

The mapped heritage point lies near the west end of the granary. The written record ties the remnant to the west extension of the granary’s north wall. Break positions and remaining heights are estimated.

The national heritage record locates the novitiate adjoining the southern arcade. The written survey documents brick remains on its south side and foundations mostly under sod. The model shows an estimated low visible fragment only.
